title: 心理と情報デザイン
subtitle: Psychology and Information Design
educationalGoal: Our department aims to cultivate individuals capable of applying the knowledge and skills acquired at institute to a broad societal perspective, contributing to richer and more fulfilling lives through information design. To this end, this course focuses on exploring the expanding scope of research areas, particularly in psychology, as well as understanding the connection between research and society. Through this, students will develop a foundation for considering not only their college life but also how to build their careers in the future.
advice: The goal of this course is not to acquire knowledge or skills in a specific field but to gain a deeper understanding of the department and prepare students for a fulfilling college life. To make the most of the next four years, students are encouraged to actively engage in various activities.

activityGoals.body: Understand the learning framework within the department and establish a clear pathway for their academic journey
Understand the relationship between studies in the department and society
Learn about the research areas of each laboratory in the department and begin to contemplate their own research
Acquire a basic understanding of the relationship between humans and information design

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
